sources.document_title: Futures USDⓈ-M — WebSocket Market Streams — Connect
semantic_assertions: Use routed PUBLIC/MARKET/PRIVATE bases.
Symbols are lowercase; raw ws and combined stream access exist.
Connection lifetime is 24h; server ping interval 3min; pong timeout 10min.
Limit: 10 incoming messages/s and 1024 streams/connection.

sources.document_title: Important WebSocket Change Notice — Base URL Split & Migration
semantic_assertions: Diff depth belongs to PUBLIC; aggregate trades belong to MARKET.
Use explicit routed paths; separate connections by traffic type.

sources.document_title: Public — Futures USDⓈ-M WebSocket Market Streams / Diff. Book Depth Streams
semantic_assertions: 100ms depth route is /public/ws/{symbol}@depth@100ms.
U/u are first/final update IDs; pu is previous event final update ID.
E/T denote event/transaction time; b/a are bid/ask price-quantity levels.
Migration fields: st=1 UM, st=2 CM; ps denotes pair.
Ordinary depth excludes RPI orders.

sources.document_title: Market — Futures USDⓈ-M WebSocket Market Streams / Aggregate Trade Streams
semantic_assertions: Route /market/ws/{symbol}@aggTrade.
Aggregate same-price/same-taking-side fills at 100ms intervals.
Insurance-fund and ADL trades are excluded.
a is aggregate ID; f/l first/last trade IDs; E/T event/trade times; m is buyer-maker flag.
q includes RPI; nq excludes RPI; individual RPI membership is not tagged.
Migration st: 1=UM, 2=CM.

sources.document_title: How to manage a local order book correctly
semantic_assertions: Buffer depth before snapshot; snapshot request limit=1000.
Drop u<S; first applied event satisfies U<=S<=u.
Later pu must equal prior u; mismatch restarts synchronization.
Level quantities are absolute; zero removes; deleting an absent level is normal.

sources.document_title: Market Data — Futures USDⓈ-M REST API / Exchange Information
semantic_assertions: GET /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo returns current rules and symbols.
Preserve status, symbol/assets and filters.
pricePrecision is not tickSize; quantityPrecision is not stepSize.

sources.document_title: Market Data — Futures USDⓈ-M REST API / Order Book
semantic_assertions: GET /fapi/v1/depth accepts limit up to 1000.
Response includes lastUpdateId,E,T,bids,asks with price-quantity pairs.
Ordinary snapshot excludes RPI.

sources.document_title: Market Data — Futures USDⓈ-M REST API / Recent Trades List
semantic_assertions: GET /fapi/v1/trades returns individual market trade records.
Insurance-fund and ADL trades are excluded.
Response fields include isBuyerMaker and isRPITrade.
PRICE_FILTER supplies tickSize.
LOT_SIZE defines symbol quantity increments/bounds; MARKET_LOT_SIZE applies to MARKET orders.
